title: Development of Tourism at Pudimadaka Lighthouse Station
summary: E-tender for tourism development works at Pudimadaka Lighthouse Station, Atchutapuram Mandal, Visakhapatnam district, Andhra Pradesh.

procurement.issuing_office: Directorate of Lighthouses and Lightships, Deep Bhavan, Port Residential Area, Saligramapuram, Visakhapatnam

sites.name: Pudimadaka Lighthouse Station, Pudimadaka Village, Atchutapuram Mandal, Visakhapatnam District, Andhra Pradesh 531011

scope.item: Development of Tourism at Pudimadaka Lighthouse Station (no BOQ in these pages)

money.notes: Estimated cost including GST and all other taxes. EMD by DD/FDR/Bank Guarantee of any scheduled bank in favour of Director of Lighthouses and Lightships, Visakhapatnam, valid three months from technical bid opening. EMD not exempted for any bidder (NSIC/MSME exemption withdrawn because of delays); EMD forfeited if timelines not followed.

period.completion: 06 months from the commencement of work
period.bid_validity: 120 days from date of opening of financial bid

eligibility: Valid registration in appropriate category & class with CPWD, State PWD, Railways, MES, BSNL or other State/Central Government/PSU/autonomous bodies

Similar works completed in last seven years: three works each >= 40% of estimated cost, or two each >= 50%, or one >= 80%; similar works = construction of buildings including electrical works and horticulture works
PAN and GST registration; key technical personnel with qualifications; unconditional tender undertaking (Annexure V)
Tender acceptance letter (Annexure IV); non-blacklisting affidavit; income tax returns for last three years
List of relatives serving in Ministry of Shipping or DGLL
Average annual turnover of last three financial years at least 30% of estimated cost
Activity chart/plan in detail; self-assessing technical evaluation sheet
notes: Extract of pages 3-7 of a 107-page tender document (Section I NIT only); no BOQ. Bid download/submission 23/12/2022 18:00 to 10/01/2023 15:00. Heavy vehicles permitted to site; contractor liable for damage to pathway tiles/paver blocks/plants. No time extension for document submission.
